verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a cloud application platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no export capability for account data, databases, or configuration in open formats. Opening a psql session, Docker support, render.yaml Blueprints, and disk snapshots or point-in-time recovery are adjacent building blocks or recovery features, not a documented way to export your data and leave.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
